name: Stick War II: Definitive Edition
storyline: Following the destruction of the rebel nations in Inamorta, a ruthless new threat known as the Chaos Empire emerges, forcing the Order Empire to fight for its survival.
summary: Stick War 2: Definitive Edition is a free, non-profit fan restoration of the classic 2012 Flash RTS game for Android. It features the original Order Campaign alongside new Chaos and Elemental campaigns, Sandbox mode, local/network multiplayer, custom skins, and mobile-optimized controls.
